I now approach food with a balanced perspective, no longer viewing it as a source of stress but as a means to nourish and energize my body.​

Thank you Deepti! You are amazing!​

I had the pleasure of working with Deepashri to create a personalized diet plan for managing my hubby's diabetes, and I can't praise her expertise enough.

Deepashri took the time to listen to my concerns, understand my dietary preferences, and tailored a plan that worked perfectly for us

What truly sets her apart is her ability to match the nutrition without compromising on the taste.  We never felt overwhelmed by the dietary changes because she made the process manageable and enjoyable.

Whenever I had questions or needed adjustments to my plan, she was readily available and responsive.

If you're looking for a dietitian who truly cares about your well-being and is exceptionally skilled in their field, I wholeheartedly recommend Deepashri.

featured_reviews.name: Shasi Kumar Tenali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I approached Deepashri for weight loss, along with the assurance that with her diet plans I’ll not only be able to lose weight but it’ll become a part of my lifestyle. The small but effective changes she made with each diet plan gave amazing results. I was not only able to lose that excess weight but also have been able to maintain it even after being off the diet for last 4 months.
Like I said it’s become a lifestyle now!
Best part of Deepashri’s meal plans were that I never was empty stomach or felt like I was starving myself.
Thank you Deepashri for your constant support and your guidance!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Aarti your feedback means a lot!! Stay healthy dear

featured_reviews.name: Chitra Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I have till date lost 12 kilos. Believe me; given my hectic schedule, frequent travels, hormonal changes, thyroid condition, losing these 12 kilos has been a difficult journey.  Had it not been for Deepashri, I would have quit. Her simple no-nonsense diets, her encouraging words, her reasoning about how the body works, the importance she gave to my food cravings, the way she worked the diet to fit into my travel schedules – all were extremely instrumental in this loss where I gained my self confidence and happiness. Thank you, Deepashri & Diet&You !!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Chitra !! You have done a splendid job with yourself!!

featured_reviews.name: Anjali_ M
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a really great experience to lose weight and that too with homely food. I had always been sceptical of dieting and diet foods, but Deepashri provided me with such simple and effective diet charts that helped me reduce weight gradually. Also, I came to know of so many healthy options and effective ingredients that now I always include them  in my normal diet. Thank you for your guidance Deepashri.

featured_reviews.name: Duran Alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text: It's my second time around working with Deepashri to lose weight for important events and she has consistently delivered on Results. 1st time around I came down by 20 kg+ from triple digits. And now took the 30 Days weight loss challenge to shed some festive weight (7 kg+) for a wedding. Felt light weight and happy both times. 100% would recommend.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Duran ! All the best

featured_reviews.name: Sayan Datta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I worked with Sanket for about 3 months and had a great experience. I lost around 10 pounds, but more importantly, he completely changed the way I think about diet and nutrition.
His approach was very structured, measured, and balanced, which made it easy to stay consistent. I now pay much closer attention to what I’m eating, understanding portions, calories, and overall balance in a way I never did before. Our weekly check-ins kept me accountable, and he was always open to questions and flexible with adjustments. He even created a detailed Google Sheet for me to track everything, which I still use.
I’m still a work in progress and have more to go, but the changes he helped me make, feel long-term, both physically and mentally. Really grateful for the experience and would highly recommend Sanket.

Need to make changes?
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks a lot Sayan for such a positive feedback!

featured_reviews.name: Ujjwal Muniraju
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m genuinely so happy with my experience with Element Nutrition. I started at 86 kg, and in just 3 months, with Sanketh’s guidance, I reached 76 kg in a healthy and realistic way.

What meant the most to me was how personal and thoughtful the whole process was. Even though I live in Sweden, Sanketh took the time to look up products from Swedish supermarkets and built a plan that actually suited my daily life. Our weekly check-ins never felt formal or forced, they were friendly, understanding, and always encouraging.

I also really admire Sanketh for his honesty and professionalism. He never overpromised anything or gave me any “magic solution.” It was all practical, doable advice. And the fact that he continued to support me even while going through a personal loss says a lot about his dedication and the kind of person he is.

Most importantly, the diet never felt like a punishment. It slowly became a natural part of my lifestyle, and that’s what made the biggest difference.

If you’re looking for someone who truly cares, listens, and guides you with sincerity, I wholeheartedly recommend Sanketh and Element Nutrition.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks a lot Ujjwal, it was great working with you and I am very happy to see your progress! Best of luck and stay healthy!

featured_reviews.name: Binali
featured_reviews.review_text: Sanket is a fantastic nutritionist! I followed his three-month plan, which included weekly check-ins. He really listens to your concerns. If you have health or fitness goals, he’s there to help. He suggests affordable foods and tailors his advice to your situation. If you feel you can’t exercise or spare much time for your health, he’ll find practical solutions that work for you. I highly recommend him—let Sanket help you improve your health!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you very much Binali!

featured_reviews.name: Pragati Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s nearly been a month since I started the diet plan with Element Nutrition and I can see great changes in my daily lifestyle which includes following healthier eating options and working on my physique to become a fitter version of myself. I am now more aware of what nutrients my body requires and also in what quantity. Regular check in calls and daily logs of the dietary plan makes it easier to be more consistent with the plan. Sanket is absolutely great, he is full of knowledge, very professional and really listens and understands your concerns. His extensive knowledge paired with his incredibly kind nature allows him to provide tailored guidance across all areas of living a better life. I would highly recommend anyone considering booking an appointment with him - you will not regret it!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are really glad that you have progressed so much with us. It wouldn't have been possible without all your efforts!

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Dholani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing experience with very quick results -- Sanket's diet plan is effective yet easy to follow because of the variety of options/combinations includes in his diet plan. The daily reporting and weekly calls help a lot with staying accountable as well!

I was able to get to my target weight in ~4-5 weeks, and fulfil my other health goals by the end of my programme. Have already referred Sanket to a couple of my friends!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks for the review Pratik!

featured_reviews.name: Pranav Kale
featured_reviews.review_text: Unlike other nutritionists, Sanket is a much more adaptive and gentler person who truly understands where you are and builds on top of that, rather than imposing a one-size-fits-all template. Working with Sanket was amazing. He is a great listener who helped me immensely with my IBS and digestive issues. He created a personalized plan tailored to my specific needs and helped me build good habits along the way. Sanket's supportive and understanding approach made all the difference in my journey to better health.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your review Pranav, you have been one of the most insightful clients that I've had the pleasure to work with!

featured_reviews.name: Ishan Bhavsar
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking for a sustainable diet plan (not a crash course) and which should be evidence based. I got recommendation of Element Nutrition  and after a brief conversation with Sanket I was convinced about finding a right guide. As such I was not overweight but my aim was to reduce my fat content. He drafted a well sustainable diet plan for me which could easily be followed. Over and above daily checks from him helped me to stick to the plan (80%). I am able to reduce my 3 kg of weight. More importantly he has formed strong foundation of my diet plan, so it will be easier for me now to have build myself from here on.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hello, we are really glad to have worked with you. We really liked how you were more focused on improving your overall health than being obsessed with your weight. We hope to stay in touch with you in the future too!

featured_reviews.name: Rutu Bhavsar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Diet plan given by Sanket helped me  not only weight management but changed way of eating.plan given is not only sustainable but super easy to follow.overall improved my skin and hormonal levels.From daily activity levels to calorie intake and nutrition, he took very detailed care throughout the plan.
Thank you so much Element nutrition for continuous guidance and follow up through out my plan. 👍🏻👍🏻
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for the feedback Rutu!
